notes: Built like the GenStudio family card; each area opens a canvas with its products placed and the listed outside systems on from the start (the partner removes the assistants the client does not use; adding an assistant adds no hours).
The canvas title names the area (for example "Adobe agentic AI: Find new customers") if that is a small change; otherwise the canvas reads as Create your own play, as GenStudio areas do today.
The CDN stays offered, not on from the start, for Brand Visibility.

ask_it_rules: Shown at the top of each assistant connection’s card, for the partner only, in quotation marks, introduced by "Ask it:". Never in what the client reads (statement of work, RFI answers, downloads).
Where adobe_words is true the question is Adobe’s own example from the source page, word for word; otherwise it stays within what the connection does (see within).

new_connection.setup_kind: From Adobe's developer guide: your team sets it up
new_connection.label: Your client connects Brand Intelligence’s brand checks to Claude, following Adobe’s developer guide
new_connection.how: Adobe’s developer guide shows how to connect Brand Intelligence’s brand checks (Validate) to a chat assistant, with Claude Desktop as its example. Once connected, a marketer gives Claude an image or a link and asks for a brand check; Brand Intelligence runs the check against the brand’s guidelines, and Claude reports the findings as they come back.
